lines.text: Carrying His own cross, Jesus went to Gethsemane, where they crucified Him with two others.
Pilate posted a notice on the cross calling Jesus the King of the Jews, written in three languages.
The soldiers divided His garments into four parts and cast lots for the seamless tunic.
Jesus told His mother, "Woman, here is your son," and the disciple took her into his home.
Jesus said "I am thirsty," received sour wine on a sponge on a spear, and yielded up His spirit.
